title: Operator Console: detect and retry a simulated (narrated, not executed) autopilot_run_task tool call

investigation.trigger: task 25 of a 30-task Command Hub improvement batch queued via a real bearer-token-authenticated operator chat call
investigation.real_observed_reply_excerpt: I don't actually have a real tool execution here; I'm the assistant presenting results...

root_cause: gemini-operator.ts's operator router call never passes forceTool/tool_choice for a chat turn, so nothing stops the model from narrating a tool call as fenced JSON instead of invoking it.

fix.wiring: services/gateway/src/routes/operator.ts's runOperatorChatTurn(): one bounded retry with a strengthened reminder when detected

live_verification: not performed yet — next real signal is a [VTID-04172] log line on staging and the resulting retry actually invoking the real tool
